name: AWS tag orphan cleanup
__comment__: AWSTag nodes are keyed by Key:Value and shared across accounts, so they have no sub resource to scope a node cleanup to. The per-account TAGGED MatchLink cleanup removes stale relationships; this job then removes the tag nodes that no relationship uses any more.

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: TAGGED relationships written before AWSTag moved to the data model have no _sub_resource_id, so the MatchLink cleanup never matches them. Remove this account's stale ones. Will be removed in v1.0.0.
statements.query: MATCH (:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->()-[r:TAGGED]->(:AWSTag) WHERE r._sub_resource_id IS NULL AND r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE r RETURN COUNT(*) AS TotalCompleted

statements.__comment__: Delete stale tag nodes that no relationship still uses. Tags written in the current sync are kept, because another account may be about to link them.
statements.query: MATCH (n:AWSTag) WHERE NOT (n)--() AND n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE n RETURN COUNT(*) AS TotalCompleted
